name: We Met v8.9.0 Mobile Usability Refresh
changes: Reworks customer, listener and admin mobile sizing so signed-in views stay inside the device width and 100dvh height
Makes customer and listener bottom navigation edge-to-edge and non-floating on phones
Simplifies back navigation to a lightweight icon button
Redesigns listener Earnings with one clear balance card, compact four-metric strip, flat payout form and flat history rows
Removes nonessential listener page descriptions and profile-menu helper copy
Compacts customer discovery, wallet, profile and messaging for phone screens while retaining touch-friendly controls
Improves admin phone containment, header, forms, tables, listener editor and full-screen modals
Keeps Razorpay direct Wallet overlay behavior from v8.8.0 and bumps all service-worker/cache versions to v8.9.0
